newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin group restructures operations.
newsitem.headline: Marlin group restructures operations.

text.p: Marlin Holdings Ltd, Marlin Corp Ltd, Minaco Granite & Marble Ltd and Kudu Granite Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday they were involved in the restructuring of their operations.
If successful, the restructuring could affect the market prices of the shares of the companies, they said in a joint announcement.

The purpose of the restructuring was to rationalise and streamline operational structures which had resulted from recent acquisitions and to align the group to ensure greater synergy and operational focus.
It would be effected by transferring:
- the Rustenburg quarries into and within Kudu;
- the beneficiation activities into and within Minaco;
- all other quarries and foreign operations into and within Marcorp; and
- Marcorp would also perform the marketing and shipping activities of the group.
In addition, agreement to acquire the remaining two-thirds of Natural Stone Processors, not currently owned by the group, were close to completion.
Shareholders in the four companies were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings until further notice.
